react/no-did-update-set-state.whyOxlintDivergence: ESLint's rule switches itself off on React >= 16.3: makeNoMethodSetStateRule's shouldBeNoop returns true for componentDidUpdate once the detected version is at or above 16.3.0 (node_modules/eslint-plugin-react/lib/util/makeNoMethodSetStateRule.js), and both probe configs set settings.react.version to detect against React 19. oxlint's port has no such version gate, so it still reports. The sibling no-will-update-set-state has no noop entry and reports on both tools, which is the control for this row.
